others.route: Work permit (Labour Code, Work Permits Division)

note: Antigua and Barbuda: a person who isn't a citizen may not engage in employment or self-employment there without a work permit issued for the Minister, applied for at the Labour Department's Employment Service (Labour Code, Cap. 27, ss. F4–F5). OECS citizens work freely (the oecs list), then CARICOM's skilled nationals on the Skills Certificate (the csme list). No days without a permit.
